entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marvin Camel is a Native American former professional boxer who competed from 1974 to 1990. He was the first cruiserweight world champion, having held the WBC title in 1980 and the IBF title from 1983 to 1984. He is also the first Native American to become a major world boxing champion.
